items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: Interviewer mentions: 'I think the Pop Swaster played the bass at that time.' Interviewee responds only about his father and Armstrong, showing no personal connection to Swaster.

ctx.x: Yes. When, uh, did you get to hear that band ever?

I, and, you get on the boat or hear it from over on the wharf and they'd play before they'd start? How did it sound? Yes. They made a record once. I don't believe your father's on it. I think the Pop Swaster played the bass at that time. And the record was, it wasn't electric recording. It's not too good a record. It's hard to tell from that whether, how wonderful the band is. But everybody talks about how great it was. That's when they had Armstrong and the St. Cyr.
Well, my daddy was there when Armstrong came on the boat.
